dish.note: Lemonade with a raspberry syrup float that turns it pink as you stir, tested on Sherman first.
dish.how: Stir the lemon juice and sugar with 250ml cold water until the sugar dissolves. Fill 4 glasses with ice, pour in the lemonade and top with soda water. Spoon 1 tbsp raspberry syrup over the back of a spoon into each so it sinks, and stir at the table.
dish.make_ahead: Make the lemon base up to a day ahead and chill; add the syrup at the table

steps.text: Stir the lemon juice and sugar with cold water until dissolved.
Pour over ice, top with soda and float the raspberry syrup on top.
